query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQD_DEFECT (STEP_SEQ, DEFECTID, WAFER_SEQ, X, Y, XREL, YREL, XINDEX, YINDEX, XSIZE, YSIZE, DEFECTAREA, DSIZE, CLASSNUMBER, TEST, CLUSTERNUMBER, ROUGHBINNUMBER, FINEBINNUMBER, REVIEWSAMPLE, IMAGECOUNT, ADDER, FIRST_STEP, RETICLE_REPEAT_ID, DIE_REPEAT_ID, MAN_OPT_CLASS, AUTO_OPT_CLASS, MAN_SEM_CLASS, AUTO_SEM_CLASS) VALUES( :step_seq,:defectid,:wafer_seq,:x,:y ,:xrel,:yrel,:xindex,:yindex,:xsize ,:ysize,:defectarea,:dsize,:classnumber,:test ,:clusternumber,:roughbinnumber,:finebinnumber,:reviewsample ,:imagecount,:adder,:first_step,:reticle_repeat_id,:die_repeat_id,:man_opt_class ,:auto_opt_class,:man_sem_class,:auto_sem_class)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND STEP_SEQ = :step_seq
IMPORT FROM :file OF DEL INSERT INTO TDMS_DEFECT

SELECT STEP_SEQ,DEFECTID,WAFER_SEQ,X,Y,XREL,YREL,XINDEX,YINDEX,XSIZE,YSIZE,DEFECTAREA,DSIZE,CLASSNUMBER,TEST,CLUSTERNUMBER,ROUGHBINNUMBER,FINEBINNUMBER,REVIEWSAMPLE,IMAGECOUNT,ADDER,FIRST_STEP,RETICLE_REPEAT_ID,DIE_REPEAT_ID,MAN_OPT_CLASS,AUTO_OPT_CLASS,MAN_SEM_CLASS,AUTO_SEM_CLASS FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND STEP_SEQ = :step_seq AND TEST = :test

UPDATE TQD_DEFECT SET CLASSNUMBER = :classnumber , ROUGHBINNUMBER = :roughbinnumber , FINEBINNUMBER = :finebinnumber , REVIEWSAMPLE = :reviewsample , IMAGECOUNT = :imagecount WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND STEP_SEQ = :step_seq AND DEFECTID = :defectid

UPDATE TQD_DEFECT SET CLASSNUMBER = :classnumber , ROUGHBINNUMBER = :roughbinnumber , FINEBINNUMBER = :finebinnumber , REVIEWSAMPLE = :reviewsample WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND STEP_SEQ = :step_seq AND DEFECTID = :defectid

SELECT STEP_SEQ, DEFECTID, WAFER_SEQ, X, Y, XREL, YREL, XINDEX, YINDEX, XSIZE, YSIZE, DEFECTAREA, DSIZE, CLASSNUMBER, TEST, CLUSTERNUMBER, ROUGHBINNUMBER, FINEBINNUMBER, REVIEWSAMPLE, IMAGECOUNT, ADDER, FIRST_STEP, RETICLE_REPEAT_ID, DIE_REPEAT_ID, MAN_OPT_CLASS, AUTO_OPT_CLASS, MAN_SEM_CLASS, AUTO_SEM_CLASS FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq
DECLARE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE ?? LIKE TQD_DEFECT ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS

SELECT STEP_SEQ, DEFECTID, WAFER_SEQ, X, Y, XREL, YREL, XINDEX, YINDEX, XSIZE, YSIZE, DEFECTAREA, DSIZE, CLASSNUMBER, TEST, CLUSTERNUMBER, ROUGHBINNUMBER, FINEBINNUMBER, REVIEWSAMPLE, IMAGECOUNT, ADDER, FIRST_STEP, RETICLE_REPEAT_ID, DIE_REPEAT_ID, MAN_OPT_CLASS, AUTO_OPT_CLASS, MAN_SEM_CLASS, AUTO_SEM_CLASS FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ IN (??)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq

-- Create Date : 2013-09-14 11:33:22 SELECT B.INDEX_X, B.INDEX_Y, DECODE (A.DEFECT_CNT, NULL, 0, A.DEFECT_CNT) AS DEFECT_CNT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT XINDEX AS INDEX_X, YINDEX AS INDEX_Y, COUNT (*) AS DEFECT_CNT FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq GROUP BY XINDEX, YINDEX) A, (SELECT DISTINCT INDEX_X, INDEX_Y FROM TQD_SETUP_MAP WHERE SETUP_SEQ IN (SELECT SETUP_SEQ FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE 1 = 1 AND STEP_SEQ = :step_seq)) B WHERE A.INDEX_X(+) = B.INDEX_X AND A.INDEX_Y(+) = B.INDEX_Y
-- Create Date : 2013-09-14 15:09:50 SELECT COUNT(*) CNT, 'N' NEW_CARRYOVER_MISSING FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ=:stepSeq

-- Create Date : 2013-09-14 15:40:38 -- NEW, front 20170, back 20292 SELECT TQD_DEFECT.*, 'N' NEW_CARRYOVER_MISSING FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ=:secondStepSeq AND (ROUND(X / ??), ROUND(Y / ??)) NOT IN ( SELECT ROUND(X / ??), ROUND(Y / ??) FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ=:firstStepSeq ) UNION ALL -- CARRYOVER, front 20170, back 20292 SELECT TQD_DEFECT.*, 'C' NEW_CARRYOVER_MISSING FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ=:firstStepSeq AND (ROUND(X / ??), ROUND(Y / ??)) IN ( SELECT ROUND(X / ??), ROUND(Y / ??) FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ=:secondStepSeq ) UNION ALL -- MISSING, front 20170, back 20292 SELECT TQD_DEFECT.*, 'M' NEW_CARRYOVER_MISSING FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ=:firstStepSeq AND (ROUND(X / ??), ROUND(Y / ??)) NOT IN ( SELECT ROUND(X / ??), ROUND(Y / ??) FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ=:secondStepSeq )

GROUP BY XINDEX,YINDEX ) A, ( SELECT DISTINCT INDEX_X,INDEX_Y FROM TQD_SETUP_MAP WHERE SETUP_SEQ IN (SELECT SETUP_SEQ FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE 1=1 AND STEP_SEQ = :step_seq) ) B WHERE A.INDEX_X(+) = B.INDEX_X AND A.INDEX_Y(+) = B.INDEX_Y
-- Create Date : 2013-11-13 22:11:05 SELECT TQD_DEFECT.*, 'N' NEW_CARRYOVER_MISSING FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ=:StepSeq

-- Create Date : 2015-03-09 11:45:50 SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROUND(XREL / ??) REPEAT_XREL, ROUND(YREL / ??) REPEAT_YREL, COUNT(*) CNT FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ=:stepSeq GROUP BY ROUND(XREL / ??), ROUND(YREL / ??) ) WHERE CNT >= :cnt
-- Create Date : 2015-03-09 11:47:03 SELECT TQD_DEFECT.*, ROUND(XREL / ??) REPEAT_XREL, ROUND(YREL / ??) REPEAT_YREL FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ=:stepSeq

-- Create Date : 2015-03-09 11:47:27 SELECT A.* , ROUND((A.XREL + B.DIE_SHOT_X * ??) / ??) REPEAT_XREL , ROUND((A.YREL + B.DIE_SHOT_Y * ??) / ??) REPEAT_YREL FROM TQD_DEFECT A, TQD_SHOT B WHERE A.STEP_SEQ=:stepSeq AND B.PRODUCT=:product AND A.XINDEX=B.INDEX_X AND A.YINDEX=B.INDEX_Y

-- Create Date : 2015-03-09 11:47:42 SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROUND((A.XREL + B.DIE_SHOT_X * ??) / ??) REPEAT_XREL , ROUND((A.YREL + B.DIE_SHOT_Y * ??) / ??) REPEAT_YREL , COUNT(*) CNT FROM TQD_DEFECT A, TQD_SHOT B WHERE A.STEP_SEQ=:stepSeq AND B.PRODUCT=:product AND A.XINDEX=B.INDEX_X AND A.YINDEX=B.INDEX_Y GROUP BY ROUND((A.XREL + B.DIE_SHOT_X * ??) / ??) , ROUND((A.YREL + B.DIE_SHOT_Y * ??) / ??) ) WHERE CNT >= ??

SELECT A.STEP_SEQ, A.DEFECTID, A.WAFER_SEQ, A.X, A.Y, A.XREL, A.YREL, A.XINDEX, A.YINDEX, A.XSIZE, A.YSIZE, A.DEFECTAREA, A.DSIZE, A.CLASSNUMBER, NVL(B.NAME, A.CLASSNUMBER) || '(' || A.CLASSNUMBER || ')' AS CLASSNUMBER_DESC, NVL(B.DEFECT_COLOR, '#FF0000') AS DEFECT_COLOR, A.TEST, A.CLUSTERNUMBER, A.ROUGHBINNUMBER, A.FINEBINNUMBER, A.REVIEWSAMPLE, A.IMAGECOUNT, A.ADDER, A.FIRST_STEP, A.RETICLE_REPEAT_ID, A.DIE_REPEAT_ID, A.MAN_OPT_CLASS, A.AUTO_OPT_CLASS, A.MAN_SEM_CLASS, A.AUTO_SEM_CLASS, C.IMAGE_ID, C.IMAGE_TYPE, C.IMAGE_PATH, C.IMAGE_FILENAME, C.IMAGE_SERVER, C.THUMB_PATH, C.THUMB_FILENAME, D.WAFER_ID, D.STEP_ID, D.RESULTTIMESTAMP FROM TQD_DEFECT A, TQD_DEFECT_TYPE B , TQD_IMAGES C, TQD_INSP_INFO D WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ IN (??) AND A.STEP_SEQ = D.STEP_SEQ AND A.CLASSNUMBER = B.CLASSNUMBER(+) AND A.STEP_SEQ = C.STEP_SEQ(+) AND A.DEFECTID = C.DEFECTID(+) ORDER BY STEP_SEQ, DEFECTID
-- Create Date : 2019-06-24 09:49:00 UPDATE TQD_DEFECT SET CLASSNUMBER = :newclass WHERE 1=1 AND STEP_SEQ = :stepseq AND DEFECTID = :defectid AND WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq AND CLASSNUMBER = :classnum

-- Create Date : 2019-07-18 14:22:14 SELECT STEP_SEQ, WAFER_SEQ, COUNT(CLASSNUMBER) AS "CNT" FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE 1=1 AND STEP_SEQ IN (??) AND CLASSNUMBER != 0 GROUP BY STEP_SEQ, WAFER_SEQ ORDER BY STEP_SEQ, WAFER_SEQ

SELECT STEP_SEQ, DEFECTID, WAFER_SEQ, XINDEX || ',' || YINDEX AS XY, X, Y, XREL, YREL, XINDEX, YINDEX, XSIZE, YSIZE, DEFECTAREA, DSIZE, CLASSNUMBER, TEST, CLUSTERNUMBER, ROUGHBINNUMBER, FINEBINNUMBER, REVIEWSAMPLE, IMAGECOUNT, ADDER, FIRST_STEP, RETICLE_REPEAT_ID, DIE_REPEAT_ID, MAN_OPT_CLASS, AUTO_OPT_CLASS, MAN_SEM_CLASS, AUTO_SEM_CLASS FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND STEP_SEQ = :step_seq

SELECT X, Y FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ IN ( SELECT STEP_SEQ FROM ( SELECT STEP_SEQ FROM TQD_STEP WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN ( SELECT WAFER_SEQ FROM TQD_WAFER WHERE WAFER_ID = :WAFER_ID AND TEST_ORDER = 0 ) AND STEP_ID <> :STEP_ID AND RESULTTIMESTAMP < TO_DATE(:RESULTTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC ) )
DELETE FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND STEP_SEQ = :step_seq
UPDATE TQD_DEFECT SET DEFECTAREA = 0 WHERE 1 = 1 AND STEP_SEQ = :step_seq
UPDATE TQD_DEFECT SET STEP_SEQ = :newstepseq, WAFER_SEQ = :newwaferseq WHERE 1 = 1 AND STEP_SEQ = :oristepseq AND WAFER_SEQ = :oriwaferseq
SELECT XINDEX, YINDEX, COUNT (*) AS CNT FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE 1 = 1 AND STEP_SEQ IN (??) GROUP BY XINDEX, YINDEX

SELECT A.DEFECTID, A.X, A.Y, A.XREL, A.YREL, A.XSIZE, A.YSIZE, A.DEFECTAREA, A.DSIZE, A.CLASSNUMBER, --NVL(B.NAME, A.CLASSNUMBER) || '(' || A.CLASSNUMBER || ')' AS CLASSNUMBER_DESC, --NVL(B.DEFECT_COLOR, '#FF0000') AS DEFECT_COLOR, A.TEST, A.CLUSTERNUMBER, --A.ROUGHBINNUMBER, --A.FINEBINNUMBER, --A.REVIEWSAMPLE, A.IMAGECOUNT, A.ADDER, --A.FIRST_STEP, --A.RETICLE_REPEAT_ID, --A.DIE_REPEAT_ID, --A.MAN_OPT_CLASS, A.XINDEX, A.YINDEX, --A.AUTO_OPT_CLASS, --A.MAN_SEM_CLASS, --A.AUTO_SEM_CLASS, --C.IMAGE_ID, --C.IMAGE_TYPE, --C.IMAGE_PATH, --C.IMAGE_FILENAME, --C.IMAGE_SERVER, --C.THUMB_PATH, --C.THUMB_FILENAME, --D.WAFER_ID, --D.STEP_ID, --D.RESULTTIMESTAMP, A.STEP_SEQ, A.WAFER_SEQ FROM TQD_DEFECT A --TQD_DEFECT_TYPE B, --TQD_IMAGES C, --TQD_INSP_INFO D WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ IN (??) --AND A.STEP_SEQ = D.STEP_SEQ --AND A.CLASSNUMBER = B.CLASSNUMBER(+) --AND A.STEP_SEQ = C.STEP_SEQ(+) --AND A.DEFECTID = C.DEFECTID(+) ?? ORDER BY STEP_SEQ, DEFECTID
UPDATE TQD_DEFECT A SET A.IMAGECOUNT = ( SELECT COUNT(B.STEP_SEQ) FROM TQD_IMAGES B WHERE A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ(+) AND A.DEFECTID = B.DEFECTID(+) ) WHERE A.STEP_SEQ = :STEP_SEQ
SELECT STEP_SEQ, X, Y FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ IN (??) ORDER BY STEP_SEQ, DEFECTID
SELECT X, Y FROM TQD_DEFECT WHERE STEP_SEQ = :STEP_SEQ ORDER BY DEFECTID
